name: same_method_limited_24h
notes: Same author model, 1024 width, 18 experts, objectives, PPR and official splits; reductions affect updates, repeats and head budgets.
Max update counts are cumulative, including an existing resumed checkpoint. These are partial epochs, never eight completed paper epochs.
One downstream seed and one official Wiki-CS split; no fabricated ten-seed mean/std.
A 24-hour wall deadline stops work and reports incomplete/failed/deferred jobs honestly; it cannot guarantee every job succeeds.
Exact full-neighbor inference is retained. A batch-of-one retry on CUDA OOM is logged; no CPU, width reduction or PPR inference fallback.
Only two selected ablations are run, each followed by Ele-fashion NC. Remaining ablations are omitted and reported.
